description: This file defines a Logger class that acts as a bridge between Nest.js Logger and the tslog library, providing configurable logging with context prefixes and different log levels.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A class that bridges Nest.js logging with tslog, supporting configurable levels, prefixes, and sub-loggers.

methods.name: getSubLogger
methods.description: Creates a new Logger instance with a specific prefix for contextual logging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at the 'log' level if the minimum level allows.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an informational message if the level permits.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message if the level permits.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error message if the level permits.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message if the level permits.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a trace (verbose) message if the level permits.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal message, prepending 'fatal:' and treating it as an error.

methods.name: formatArgsAsString
methods.description: Formats multiple arguments into a single string for logging.

methods.name: logInternal
methods.description: Forwards formatted log messages to the NestLogger with appropriate level.
